Early Blight.growth_stages: Can occur at any stage, often on older leaves first.
Early Blight.monitor_signs: Dark concentric rings on older leaves, yellowing halos.
Early Blight.common_issues: Fungal infection often driven by moisture.
Early Blight.description: A fungal disease that causes concentric target-like spots.

Late Blight.monitor_signs: Water-soaked spots on leaves, white fungal growth on undersides in wet conditions.
Late Blight.common_issues: Fast spreading fungal disease, especially in cool, wet conditions.
Late Blight.description: A serious fungal disease that rapidly destroys foliage.

Bacterial Spot.monitor_signs: Small, dark, greasy spots on leaves and fruit.
Bacterial Spot.common_issues: Bacterial disease spread by splashing water.

Leaf Mold.monitor_signs: Pale green or yellowish spots on upper leaf surfaces, olive-green to brown mold on undersides.
Leaf Mold.description: Fungal disease thriving in high humidity.

Late Blight.monitor_signs: Irregular water-soaked spots, white fuzz on leaf undersides.

Common Rust.monitor_signs: Reddish-brown pustules on both leaf surfaces.

Northern Leaf Blight.monitor_signs: Long, elliptical, grayish-green or tan lesions.
Northern Leaf Blight.common_issues: Fungal disease favored by moderate temperatures and high humidity.
Northern Leaf Blight.description: Fungal disease causing long, cigar-shaped lesions.
